question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. **

Something that pertaining to the controversy
solution:
The correct answer is '**Polemical**'.

• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Polemical**'.
 
• It means 'of or involving strongly critical or disputatious writing or speech (अत्यधिक आलोचनात्मक या विवादास्पद लेखन या भाषण को शामिल करना)
